repos.description: Never stop coding. Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 359 providers (150+ free), 1200+ models Kimi, Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniMax. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Cline & Copilot. Quota-aware auto-fallback, RTK+Caveman compression saves 15-95% tokens, MCP/A2A, Desktop/PWA. Built by hundreds of contributors
repos.summary_zh: OmniRoute是一个免费MIT许可的AI网关，通过统一端点聚合359个提供商、1200+模型，支持Claude Code、Cursor等主流编码工具。其智能配额感知自动回退与RTK+Caveman压缩技术可节省高达95%的令牌成本，适用于需要低成本、多模型访问的开发者与团队。
repos.summary_en: OmniRoute is a free MIT-licensed AI gateway that aggregates 359 providers and over 1,200 models behind a unified endpoint, compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and other coding tools. It features quota-aware auto-fallback and RTK+Caveman compression to save up to 95% tokens, making it ideal for developers and teams seeking low-cost, multi-model AI access.

repos.description: 🚀 Free HTTP, SOCKS4, & SOCKS5 proxy list * Updated every 5 minutes * and rotating proxy API (100+ countries)
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库提供全球免费代理IP列表，包含HTTP、HTTPS、SOCKS4和SOCKS5协议，每5分钟更新一次。支持JSON、TXT、CSV格式下载，并提供NPM模块和API接口，适用于爬虫、匿名访问和网络测试等场景。
repos.summary_en: Provides a highly reliable, frequently updated list of free HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS4, and SOCKS5 proxies from over 140 countries. Updated every 5 minutes, it offers data in JSON, TXT, and CSV formats, along with an NPM module and rotating proxy API for seamless integration into scraping and automation workflows.

repos.description: MoonTV/LunaTV源配置，每日自动检测API状态，可在CF部署CORSAPI中转被墙API，本人提供的CORSAPI仅为测试使用，请勿滥用！
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库提供MoonTV/LunaTV的多种配置源，包括精简、完整及成人版本，满足不同用户需求。内置基于Cloudflare Workers的CORSAPI代理服务，可中转被墙API并自动添加代理前缀，解决跨域限制。支持Base58编码订阅生成，部署简便，适用于TV应用配置与API代理场景。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers multiple configuration sources for MoonTV/LunaTV, including simplified, full, and adult versions, to meet diverse user needs. It features a CORSAPI proxy service based on Cloudflare Workers, which can relay blocked APIs and automatically add proxy prefixes, addressing cross-origin restrictions. It supports Base58-encoded subscription generation, with easy deployment, suitable for TV app configuration and API proxy scenarios.

repos.description: AI Coding 福利站导航：免费白嫖 Claude Code / Codex 的中转站与公益站合集，含额度、模型、价格自动更新与一键配置脚本
repos.summary_zh: 聚合多个 AI 编码中转站与公益站，提供免费额度与一键配置脚本，助力开发者零成本体验 Claude Code、Codex 等顶级模型。实时监控站点可用性，自动更新额度与价格，支持多种协议，是 AI 编码探索的高效入口。
repos.summary_en: Aggregate multiple AI coding relay and charity stations, offering free credits and one-click setup scripts, enabling developers to access top models like Claude Code and Codex at zero cost. With real-time availability monitoring and auto-updating data, it supports multiple protocols, serving as an efficient entry point for AI coding exploration.
